liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Doin'Things Right** (4 other sources): The lyrics were changed to mention wearing a mask [1][2][3][4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Señor (Tales of Yankee Power)**: back after 50 archived shows (377 days) [15]
- **Rosa Lee McFall**: rare: 11 archived performances [15]
- **Ralph’s Banjo Special**: rare: 8 archived performances [15]
- **16/16 (1)**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **BillyStrings2020-09-12.AKG-CK63.Flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 141 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2020-09-12.litz.schoepsMK4v.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 142 min [2]
- **billystrings2020-09-12.litz.schoepsMK4v.flac2496**: source not stated; 22 songs; 142 min [3]
- **billystrings2020-09-12.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: source not stated; 22 songs; 142 min [4]

## Around the show

- The show was sold out [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **BillyStrings2020-09-12.AKG-CK63.Flac24**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: AKG CK63 ULS Hyper Mics w c480b > TASCAM DR-100mkII (24 Bit/44.1kHz) [1]
- **billystrings2020-09-12.litz.schoepsMK4v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4V's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Baby Nbox>Sony PCM-A10 [2]. Also: Schoeps MK4V mics went through a Baby Nbox into a Sony PCM-A10 at 24-bit float/96kHz, then were converted to 24-bit/48kHz [2]
- **billystrings2020-09-12.litz.schoepsMK4v.flac2496**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4V's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Baby Nbox>Sony PCM-A10(@24 BIT Float/96Khz) [3]. Also: Schoeps MK4V mics went through a Baby Nbox into a Sony PCM-A10 at 24-bit float/96kHz. This version keeps 96k and only adds fades [3]
- **billystrings2020-09-12.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's>Schoeps KCY 250/5i>Schoeps VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [4]. Also: Keith Litzenberger recorded with Schoeps MK41v mics into a Sound Devices MixPre-10 II at 32-bit float/48kHz, then converted to 24-bit [4]
